title: Eval run · MCP ask round · fixture · travel_expense × 2 arms × 1 rep · 41164656 · 2026-11-26
body:
eval#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

**No question or operation was asked on either arm, so there are no scores today.** The workspace-door host app declares `engines.protocol ^18` and the workspace runtime is protocol 19.0.0, so it was refused at boot. Both commands still exited 0. The runner built nothing, wrote no code, opened no PR, pushed nothing and made no GitHub write. I did not retry with other flags, because that would depart from the ordered command.

## Environment

- **Runner:**
  - `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at full sha `411646562566a1e12b4e0fc3de256192e8302719` (`env.framework` 41164656), held fixed.
  - `git rev-parse HEAD` is unchanged at the end, and `git status` is clean.
  - I ran `git fetch origin main` once, read-only, to see whether a later commit touches `packages/qa/scenarios`. HEAD did not move, and nothing newer on main touches it.
  - The checkout was already at the target sha, so no `git checkout` was needed.
- **Build:** `pnpm install && pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build` exited 0. The log has 47 lines matching "error", the same count as #37305. I counted them and did not read them.
- **Packages:** `workspace @ 41164656 (unreleased)`, 78 packed. #37305 had 77.
- **Driver and login:**
  - `claude-code-cli 2.1.332 (Claude Code)`, the same as #37305.
  - `claude auth status` reported `oauth_token`, and the scorecard says `API-billed: no`.
  - `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` were unset (count 0 after the unset).
  - `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` is set in the container. I left it alone.
- **Served model:** none. No turn ran, so there is no `Run · model` line. The requested config was `haiku`, effort `medium`.
- **Fixture:**
  - `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json` sha256 is `cc035a919bf530a6e06bb9770f08e4d78e96c7ff914b0ecd549282058283709d`, equal to the order's hash.
  - Its `manifest.engines.protocol` is `^19`. The provenance `amended` list records the move from `^18` against #37229, with `from` `4ab7e603…`.
  - The fixture file last changed in 204356a6 (#37314).
  - The fixture was never installed, because the host app failed first.
- **Card stamp:**
  - **Runner stamp:** `travel_expense` sha256 `212abedb6b59` (full `212abedb6b59a5ac0c6921c25bdcc4dc057cbc25e866a9cd2ed962920368a00d`), the same as `sha256sum` of the card file and the same on both arms. It is unchanged since #37305.
  - **Provenance:** `cardSha256` is now `212abedb…` and matches the card (#37339). Neither log has a `warning: template provenance` line.
- **Skill (on arm):**
  - `objectstack-ask@18.6.0`, runner-stamped sha256 `075f7cda7a2f64dfb1fea3dbeb323febe5eb57ba0b49fe24262ffdbdd5e283e1`, the same as #37305. The directory is `/home/user/objectstack/skills/objectstack-ask`, the skill directory itself.
  - Its files are `SKILL.md` `1640e62a…`, `evals/metric-selection-fallback.json` `a179eab9…` and `evals/triggers.json` `77184afe…`, all the same as #37305.
  - The skill was never loaded into a turn. The off arm has none.
- **Dates:** the runner printed `the card's 2026-10-31 is run as 2026-11-26`.
- **Start conditions:** #34911 and #34882 were not re-checked today. #37007 recorded both closed on 2026-11-17.

## Scope

- **Card and mode:** `travel_expense` (control), ask mode only, template mode. Nothing built, no iterate.
- **Planned per arm:** 10 questions as 13 persona turns, 5 dataset questions, 6 operations plus 1 `pay_claim` confirm turn, 25 ask turns.
- **Arms:** skill off and skill on, one repetition each, every flag explicit, run one after the other.
  - Common flags: `--only travel_expense --modes ask --template /home/user/objectstack/docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json --ask-repeats 1 --ask-model haiku --ask-effort medium --packages workspace --out /tmp/askd/{off,on} --record /tmp/askd/{off,on}/rec.json`.
  - The on arm adds `--ask-skills /home/user/objectstack/skills/objectstack-ask`.
  - The commands are in `/tmp/askd/run-off.sh`, `run-on.sh` and `run-both.sh`.
- **Order and times:**
  - Off ran 13:43:00Z to 13:52:51Z (9m 51s wall, mostly the workspace pack).
  - On ran 13:52:51Z to 13:53:30Z (39s).
  - They did not overlap, and the workspace build did not collide this time.
- **Exit codes:** off `0` (`exit-off.txt`), on `0` (`exit-on.txt`). Exit 0 does not mean the arm ran. The runner records the boot failure as an ask finding and still exits 0.
- **Not measured (everything), same reason on both arms:**
  - **Questions, datasets, operations, `Run · kinds`, leak flags, the injection guardrail and the `pay_claim` confirmed write.** The ask host app never booted: `objectstack dev exited before it was ready`. The scorecard's Build, Run-问数, Run-operations and Run · model rows are all `—`. The record's results are `not-run`.
  - **Time and cost.** Ask time and ask cost are `—`: 0 turns, $0.
  - The runtime's error was `package 'com.example.hosttravel' targets protocol ^18 (engines.protocol) but this runtime is protocol 19.0.0. This is a major-version break. Run: objectstack migrate meta --from 18`.

## Results

| Arm | 问数 (13 turns) | `Run · datasets` (5) | Run-operations (6 + confirm) | leak flags | minutes · nominal $ |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| skill off | not measured | not measured | not measured | not measured | 0 ask turns · $0 |
| skill on | not measured | not measured | not measured | not measured | 0 ask turns · $0 |

- **`Run · kinds`:** not measured on either arm.
- **Per question, both arms:** all 18 question and dataset turns and all 7 operation turns are `not measured` on both arms. I have no pass or fail to put in the table, so I do not build one.

## Reading

This is one repetition per arm, and neither arm produced a reading. Nothing can be compared with #37305 in counts, and none of the filing rules can be applied.

1. **Against #37305 (11-25, off / on 问数 8/13 and 11/13, combined 12/18 and 16/18):** there is no count to compare. Do not read today as a regression or a recovery.
2. **Cause (read from the code, not tested):**
   - In workspace mode the runner scaffolds the ask host app with this checkout's own `create-objectstack`. `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/cli.ts:328-329` says it "scaffolds with the one this checkout builds".
   - Its blank template, `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/objectstack.config.ts:38`, carries `engines: { protocol: '^18' }`.
   - The scaffold test, `template-version-stamps.test.ts`, says `engines.protocol` is stamped from the package version's major. I did not read the stamping code itself.
   - `packages/create-objectstack/package.json` and `packages/spec/package.json` are both still `18.6.0`, while `packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts:27` has `PROTOCOL_VERSION = '19.0.0'`.
   - So the host app is stamped `^18` and the runtime it boots on is 19.0.0, and the load-time handshake refuses it. This is inferred from the diff and the test, not confirmed against the stamping code.
   - The fixture's `^19` was not the thing refused. The runner's own host app was, before the fixture installed.
3. **Variables changed since 4fb03ebb (#37305), all unrelated to today's failure except the protocol bump:**
   - **Protocol bump (#37314, 204356a6):** `PROTOCOL_VERSION` 18 to 19. It also moved the fixture's `manifest.engines.protocol` to `^19` (the amendment recorded against #37229).
   - **Scorer (#37346, 7f62348d):** asked-back no-figure now reads a markdown list marker as numbering. This touches `scenario-dataset-grade.ts` and its test.
   - **Provenance (#37339, a182fbe3):** the `cardSha256` fix, plus a stale-provenance warning in `cli.ts`.
   - **Other commits touching `packages/qa/scenarios`, `docs/qa/scenarios` or `skills/objectstack-ask`:** none. These three are the only ones in 4fb03ebb..HEAD.
   - **Skill:** `075f7cda…`, unchanged. **CLI:** 2.1.332, unchanged. Model, effort, repetitions and the card are unchanged.
   - **Packages:** `workspace @ 41164656`, 78 packed. Today's door has everything merged since 4fb03ebb (123 commits).
4. **#34687 6952197238 addition 3, against #37305:**
   - **Not applicable today.** No question lost or passed, so the "two consecutive days" and "both arms today" triggers cannot fire.
   - **Still open from #37305, seat's call, unchanged by today:** `claims_by_status`, `top_claimants`, `sales_paid_hotel` (off arm) and `dq_claimed_so_far` (off arm).
5. **Does `top_claimants` still lose? Does `claims_by_status` still lose?** Not measured. Today says nothing about either.
6. **Does the `run_action` first-call 500 (#36490) recur?** Not measured. No operation ran.
7. **What would give a reading:** a round on a door whose scaffolded host app and runtime agree on the protocol major. I did not try one. The ordered `--packages workspace` fails as above, and `--create-version` is refused with `--packages workspace` by `cli.ts:328`. I have not tested what the published 18.6.0 door does with a `^19` fixture. The next step is the seat's call.

## Loss attribution

None: no question was asked, so there is no agent, scorer or card loss to attribute.

- **Not an agent loss:** the boot failure is `P`, platform or tooling, in the workspace-door scaffold versus the protocol bump. It is not a model result and not a scorer question.
- **Filing candidate (seat's call):** a runner-or-create-objectstack defect. At this sha the workspace door cannot boot its own ask host app, because the scaffold stamps `engines.protocol ^18` and the runtime is 19. The code references are in Reading item 2.
- **Runner behaviour worth a card:** a boot failure that leaves 0 turns run still exits 0. Today's exit codes read as success.

## Records

- **Off:** `/tmp/askd/off/` holds `2026-11-26-scenario-travel_expense.json`, `rec.json` (sha256 `91831b0fa9b01eba21c997982ac9858b7c7c70099601e512080e096948014094`) and `run.log`. The evidence dir is `/tmp/scenario-run-W9b5pS`.
- **On:** `/tmp/askd/on/` holds the same three files, and `rec.json` has sha256 `5d5cd332685d24a387a044fefe5afb953d45396e1fe554387c267a1f431fe0b4`. The evidence dir is `/tmp/scenario-run-mLxeti`.
- **Other:** `/tmp/askd/` also holds `build.log`, `build-exit.txt`, `both.log`, the run scripts, `start-*.txt`, `end-*.txt` and `exit-*.txt`.
- **Skill directory:** `/home/user/objectstack/skills/objectstack-ask`.
- The `rec.json` files hold no turns, so they replay nothing. They are outside the repository tree, and the container is ephemeral, so copy what you need before it is reclaimed.

## Seat note
- The cause is already carded: #37586 (stamp the blank template's `engines.protocol` from `PROTOCOL_VERSION`), under #37441. The daily round is blocked until it lands.
- A published fallback is not possible: the fixture is now `^19`, and published 18.6.0 runs protocol 18.
- The exit-0-on-boot-failure behaviour is carded separately (see the note on #34869).

Security: none. The runner's private section is withheld and held nothing.
